trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Definition block, read in full. All ten categories clean. 'The Reeb bundle provides three structures. The base ... The fibre ... The total space ...' is NOT a compulsive triple: base, fibre and total space are the canonical and exhaustive trichotomy of a fibre bundle, so the three-ness is forced by the object. No dashes, no closer, no meta-commentary, no superlatives. NOTATION PASS: the block uses the current QOU archimedean 4-tuple (C, Theta, G, S) rather than the deprecated 5-tuple (M, Theta, G, P, E) -- correct per AGENTS.md SS7; S_p is written as the exceptional divisor P^1(C) = S^2 and the Hopf fibration S^3 -> S^2 is correctly oriented; [2]_q = q + q^{-1} is the right quantum integer. RIGOR CHECK on the holonomy: e^{2 pi i/[2]_q} gives 2 pi/[2]_q = 3.12446 rad at the proton pin, and at q = 1 it degenerates to e^{i pi} = -1, the standard Hopf/spinor holonomy -- a good consistency check that the [2]_q normalisation is the intended one.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: One precision note, not fixed. 'the holonomy around a generator of pi_1(S^1)' is loose: holonomy of a principal U(1)-bundle is taken around a loop in the BASE, and here the base S_p = S^2 is simply connected, so pi_1(S^1) must mean the fibre circle's fundamental class or a loop in a punctured chart. As written the phrase does not name a loop the holonomy can be evaluated on. Proposed fix: say which loop (e.g. 'around the fibre generator', or 'around a meridian of the punctured base').
